T0594.title: Decentralized Identity
T0594.definition: An identity model based on decentralized identifiers, verifiable credentials, and user-controlled proof presentation.
T0594.description: Decentralized identity combines DIDs, verifiable credentials, and user-controlled wallets so identity claims can be verified across platforms. It reduces reliance on a single identity provider but creates risks around key custody, recovery, credential over-issuance, privacy correlation, and interoperability.
T0594.usageExample: Assess Decentralized Identity related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
